description: Golden fixtures for the Runbook Executor. The eval path runs with skip_approval=True (no approver), so destructive steps deterministically resolve to 'denied' at the HITL gate while non-destructive steps execute autonomously. Cases assert selection + the resolution status + step accounting, not exact LLM strings (RA-004 uses no LLM).

cases.description: Payment OOM crashloop selects the payment runbook; the destructive restart is gated -> denied; the safe drain step ran.
Service 'payment-service' normalizes to 'payment' and still selects the payment runbook.
Cart latency under load selects the scale-up runbook; snapshot runs, scale-up is gated.
A service with no matching runbook returns a clean 'no_runbook' outcome rather than guessing.
